scripts.script:
-- if we dont hav this then no work ayy 😂😂
local Players = cloneref(game:GetService("Players"))
local RunService = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
local me = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

if not hookfunction or not getgc then
    warn("Executor doesn't support hookfunction/getgc")
    return
end

local islclosure = islclosure or islua or function(f)
    return type(f) == "function"
end

local FOV = 150
local Chance = 100
local target = nil

if FOV > 0 and Drawing then
    local circle = Drawing.new("Circle")
    circle.Thickness = 1
    circle.NumSides = 64
    circle.Radius = FOV
    circle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    circle.Transparency = 0.5
    circle.Filled = false
    circle.Visible = true

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        circle.Position = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    end)
end

local function GetClosestPlayer()
    target = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge
    local myTeam = me.Team

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer == me then continue end
        local otherChar = otherPlayer.Character
        if not otherChar then continue end

        local otherRoot = otherChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local otherHum = otherChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local otherHead = otherChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not otherRoot or not otherHead or not otherHum or otherHum.Health <= 0 then continue end
        if myTeam and otherPlayer.Team == myTeam then continue end

        local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(otherRoot.Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end

        local crosshairDist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - camera.ViewportSize / 2).Magnitude
        if FOV > 0 and crosshairDist > FOV then continue end

        if crosshairDist < closestDist then
            closestDist = crosshairDist
            target = otherHead
        end
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GetClosestPlayer)

for _, func in ipairs(getgc()) do
    if type(func) == "function" and islclosure(func) then
        local ok, info = pcall(debug.info, func, "a")
        if not ok or info ~= 2 then continue end

        local upvalues = debug.getupvalues(func)
        local constants = debug.getconstants(func)
        if not upvalues or not constants then continue end
        if #upvalues ~= 2 or #constants ~= 17 then continue end

        local originalFunc
        originalFunc = hookfunction(func, function(rayArg, secondArg)
            if target and math.random(1, 100) <= Chance then
                local myHead = me.Character and me.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if myHead then
                    rayArg = Ray.new(myHead.Position, target.Position - myHead.Position)
                end
            end
            return originalFunc(rayArg, secondArg)
        end)
  print("hooked jk 😂🎶🎶👏👍👍🙌😎🎉💋💋💋😘💕")
    end
end

scripts.title: fly script
scripts.features:
RafiqHy 2 Hub 🚀
A simple and convenient script hub designed for smooth movement and character control
Controls:F — Toggle flight mode (Fly). 
N — Toggle passing through walls (Noclip). 
L / K — Adjust movement speed.   
Created by RafikHY2
scripts.script:
--[[
    Made it by RafigHy 2
    Xeno UI Script (Fixed Responsive Fly & Noclip)
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Состояние
local flyEnabled = false
local noclipEnabled = false
local speed = 50
local minSpeed = 10
local maxSpeed = 500
local speedStep = 10

-- GUI Создание
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "RafigHyGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(screenGui)
    screenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
elseif gethui then
    screenGui.Parent = gethui()
else
    screenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
end

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 165)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.2, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 25, 75)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
uiCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "RafigHy 2 Hub"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 180, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 18
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local flyStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
flyStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
flyStatus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 35)
flyStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
flyStatus.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
flyStatus.Text = "Fly [F]: OFF"
flyStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
flyStatus.TextSize = 15
flyStatus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
flyStatus.Parent = mainFrame

local noclipStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
noclipStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
noclipStatus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 60)
noclipStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
noclipStatus.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
noclipStatus.Text = "Noclip [N]: OFF"
noclipStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
noclipStatus.TextSize = 15
noclipStatus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
noclipStatus.Parent = mainFrame

local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 25)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 85)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
speedLabel.Text = "Скорость [L/K]: " .. speed
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
speedLabel.TextSize = 15
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
speedLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local creditLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
creditLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
creditLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -22)
creditLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
creditLabel.Text = "Made it by RafigHy 2"
creditLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 255)
creditLabel.TextSize = 12
creditLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
creditLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- Обновление персонажа при респавне
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    character = newChar
    humanoidRootPart = newChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    humanoid = newChar:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    flyEnabled = false
    noclipEnabled = false
    flyStatus.Text = "Fly [F]: OFF"
    flyStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    noclipStatus.Text = "Noclip [N]: OFF"
    noclipStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
end)

-- Переключение функций клавишами
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        flyEnabled = not flyEnabled
        if flyEnabled then
            flyStatus.Text = "Fly [F]: ON"
            flyStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
        else
            flyStatus.Text = "Fly [F]: OFF"
            flyStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            if humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("RafigFlyBV") then
                humanoidRootPart.RafigFlyBV:Destroy()
            end
            if humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("RafigFlyBG") then
                humanoidRootPart.RafigFlyBG:Destroy()
            end
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
        noclipEnabled = not noclipEnabled
        if noclipEnabled then
            noclipStatus.Text = "Noclip [N]: ON"
            noclipStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
        else
            noclipStatus.Text = "Noclip [N]: OFF"
            noclipStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        speed = math.clamp(speed + speedStep, minSpeed, maxSpeed)
        speedLabel.Text = "Скорость [L/K]: " .. speed
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then
        speed = math.clamp(speed - speedStep, minSpeed, maxSpeed)
        speedLabel.Text = "Скорость [L/K]: " .. speed
    end
end)

-- Основной цикл обработки движения
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not character or not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid then return end
    
    -- Noclip
    if noclipEnabled then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Fly
    if flyEnabled then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = true
        
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local bv = humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("RafigFlyBV")
        local bg = humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("RafigFlyBG")
        
        if not bv then
            bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "RafigFlyBV"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bv.Parent = humanoidRootPart
        end
        
        if not bg then
            bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            bg.Name = "RafigFlyBG"
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bg.P = 15000
            bg.Parent = humanoidRootPart
        end
        
        bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
        
        local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + (camera.CFrame.LookVector)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - (camera.CFrame.LookVector)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - (camera.CFrame.RightVector)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + (camera.CFrame.RightVector)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        bv.Velocity = moveDir * speed
    end
end)

scripts.title: ExplorerMap | Advanced Minimap and Custom Waypoints
scripts.features:
ExplorerMap combines a smooth minimap with a full navigation system for your world. Everything runs completely seamlessly, responds to your inputs, and adapts fully to your own style.

With the interactive map, you always keep track of everything. Players are shown as clear markers while you can freely drag the map around, zoom in and out, or snap right back to your position with a quick double tap. When you have a specific spot in your sights, just long press on the map to open the context menu. From there, you can drop custom waypoints that guide your path with glowing beams or teleport straight to your destination.

Through the built-in settings menu, you have full control over all important parameters like grid resolution, zoom speed, and raycast heights. An interactive tutorial walks new players step by step through every feature, but can easily be turned off whenever you want.

Whether for exploring, building, or navigating, this tool delivers maximum possible performance and a clean interface directly inside your script.

scripts.features:
​🕹️ Movement Options

​WalkSpeed & JumpPower Sliders: Adjust your movement speed and jump height in real time.

​Noclip (Wallhack Movement): Bypass wall collisions using RunService.Stepped physics manipulation to walk through solid obstacles.

​Infinite Jump: Jump repeatedly in mid-air without falling back down.

​Click TP (Ctrl + Left Click): Instantly teleport to any location targeted by your mouse cursor.

​Anti-Ragdoll / Anti-Stun: Prevents your character from going into a ragdoll state or getting knocked down by hazards/attacks.

​👁️ Visuals & ESP Engine

​Monster / Entity ESP: Highlights all NPCs, bots, and monsters in red across the map (including hidden or immortal entities).

​Player-to-Monster Detection: Automatically identifies players who have transformed into monsters/killers (e.g., in Piggy, Infection, or Flee the Facility) based on tags and team metadata.

​Player ESP: Highlights non-monster players in blue with their display names.

​Exit / Door ESP: Highlights escape doors, exits, and key pathways in green.

​Item / Loot ESP: Highlights collectible items, keys, and tools in orange.

​Fullbright / Anti-Fog: Clears map darkness and fog by adjusting ambient lighting for full visibility.

​Show Tracers: Draws 2D tracer lines from the bottom center of your screen directly to target entities.

​⚔️ Combat Adjustments

​Smart Aimlock: Automatically snaps your camera toward the nearest monster or entity within a specified distance.

​Aimlock Distance Range: Customizable slider to limit or extend the target tracking distance.

​Expand Head Hitbox: Enlarges the head size and collision zone of entities to make aiming and landing hits significantly easier.

​⚙️ Utility & Quality of Life

​God Mode: Continuously restores your character's health to maximum.

​Auto-Interact: Automatically triggers ProximityPrompt interactions (doors, levers, items) when in range.

​Anti-AFK: Sends virtual inputs to prevent Roblox from disconnecting you due to inactivity.

​Zoom Bypass: Unlocks maximum camera distance limits, allowing unlimited zoom out.

​🛡️ System & Architecture

​Weak Tables (__mode = "v" / "k"): Prevents memory leaks by allowing garbage collection to clean up deleted objects.

​Throttle Jitter Scanning: Scans workspace descendants in batches to prevent frame drops or game freezes on heavy maps.

​Character Protection System: Maintains speed and jump settings automatically when your character respawns.

​Modern Tab UI: Built-in floating toggle button, sleek animated intro screen, and sound effects for UI actions.

scripts.features:
# ⚔️ Command-An-Army Hub

Let the hub handle the boring parts while you focus on your army and the battle!

---

# 🏠 Main

Useful tools for moving around and seeing what's happening.

*  Speed Boost — Run faster with a boost from 0 to 15.
*  Infinite Mount Stamina — Keep your horse stamina longer.
*  Enemy ESP — See enemy players and troop count
*  Team ESP — See your teammates and troop count
*  Bird's-Eye Camera — Get a better view of the battlefield with P.

---

# 🤖 Smart Combat Automation

This is where the hub really gets to work.

Your character can automatically:

*  Mount your horse
*  Heal when your health gets low
*  Back away when enemies get too close
*  Move toward enemies and lead your troops
*  Attack nearby enemies automatically
*  Spawn fresh troops
*  Get unstuck if you become trapped
*  Detect cannons and stay slightly away

You can choose your heal and safe-distance settings, so the hub knows when it's safe to heal or when to back away.

---

# 🪖 Troop Automation

Your troops can handle combat on their own.

*  Automatically attack enemies
*  Choose how often attack commands are sent
*  Choose how troops are selected
*  Retreat when their health gets too low
*  Auto Re-spawn next troops - auto retreat when health too low

The hub also changes its behavior depending on your team.

Attackers push forward and fight.

Defenders focus on holding their position.

---

# 🏛️ Lobby Automation

The hub can handle a bunch of stuff between matches too.

* 🚪 Auto Join — Automatically join new matches.
* 🛡️ Pick Team — Choose Attackers or Defenders.
* 🗺️ Vote Maps
* 🎁 Claim Quests — Collect completed quest rewards.
* 🎲 Auto Summon — Summon warriors when you have enough gems.
* ⭐ Auto Ascend — Merge duplicate warriors to upgrade them.
* 💪 Auto Equip — Automatically equip your strongest warriors (archers not supported so script will auto remove them from equip)
* 🎟️ Redeem Codes — Claim available promo codes.

---

# 📱 Side Panel

Keep track of your army while playing.

* Shows your troop count
* Shows your army health
* Shows your current status
* 🛑 Emergency Stop — Quickly stop all automation

---

# ⚙️ Settings
